g.text: Read top-to-bottom: intake and AI triage feed the stores; execution, tracking, reporting and administration read them back.
Process 2.0 is decomposed further in the level-2 diagram. D5 groups the three reference tables (users, departments, zones)
because every process reads them and drawing each separately would obscure the flows that matter.
